purpose: Option 1 chosen by the user on 2026-11-20 (task-level source weight). Registered in research/PLAN.md (auto-loop) before submission. One single-GPU job: three tasks, BC-mix with source weight w in {0, 0.25, 0.5, 1}, and a model-based choice of w per (task, seed).

model.inputs_outputs: (s, a) standardized -> (s' - s, r) standardized; source normalization kept when fine-tuning (V20 FT)

rollout.member_choice: each rollout row uses an ensemble member drawn uniformly at random at every step (same draws for the four policies of one task and seed)
rollout.termination: gym v3 rules on the predicted observation: hopper z > 0.7, |angle| < 0.2, |obs[1:]| < 100; walker 0.8 < z < 2.0, |angle| < 1; velocity columns clipped to [-10, 10] as in the observation function; non-finite prediction ends the row
rollout.score: mean model return over 100 rollouts (50 reset states x 2), normalized with the ODRL reference returns
rollout.choice: the weight with the highest score; ties -> the smaller weight

rule.metric: Last5 = mean of the last five evaluation points, 10 episodes each (V21/j004-j007 metric)
rule.SEL: per (task, seed), the Last5 of the policy whose weight the model-based score chose; no policy is retrained and no return is used in the choice
rule.strong_control: per task, the higher Last5 mean of BC (W0) and BC-mix (W100) over seeds 3116-3120; T (target-only IQL) is not run (budget: one GPU) - it was below the strong control on all three tasks in j004, j005 and j006
rule.screen_effective: candidate minus strong control, paired by seed: mean > 0 and mean > 1 * paired SE
rule.supported: for a candidate (SEL, W25, W50): screen-effective on at least 2 of the 3 tasks -> confirmation with 5 never-used seeds on those tasks (T included there)
rule.rejected: paired mean difference <= 0 on at least 2 of the 3 tasks
rule.secondary: registered, not counted by the loop: SEL is robust if on every task SEL minus strong control has paired mean >= -1 * paired SE; also reported: SEL minus BC-mix on walker medium
rule.descriptive: 2 * SE criterion, Spearman correlation between model score and true Last5 over the four weights per (task, seed), chosen vs best weight, regret, SEL with the 200-step score, per-seed oracle, model validation error, BC-mix minus BC
rule.note: Rules are fixed before results; not changed after results are seen. Three candidates are compared; this is stated in the report. If any run fails, no verdict.
